fullText.simplified:
五、后记

    瞒天过海是三十六计中的第一计。有些事情，因为经常发生，人们已经习惯了，所以会相信。在攻打敌人时，我们可以把自己的目的放在这些人们已经习惯了的事情后面，让敌人没有防备，然后突然攻打敌人。上文故事中，警车每天从书店前开过，赌钱的人慢慢习惯，就没了防备。等警察突然进来抓人时，想跑已经晚了。
    现在，也有“瞒天过海”这样的事情，它是一个成语。
    比如，你和同学们都在学校里学汉语，开始的时候，大家的汉语都不太好。几个月后，学校有汉语考试。考试完，大家发现，有位同学的成绩比大家好很多。你不明白，都是一样在学校里学习，为什么这位同学的成绩比大家好这么多呢？后来你发现，这位同学除了在学校里学汉语，也在学校外面找了老师学汉语。在你们不知道的地方和你们不知道的时间里，他都在学习，但他没有告诉你们，因为他希望他的汉语比每个人都好。这时候，你就可以说：“同学，你这是在瞒天过海，明天我也会多学习的！”
fullText.traditional:
五、後記

    瞞天過海是三十六計中的第一計。有些事情，因為經常發生，人們已經習慣了，所以會相信。在攻打敵人時，我們可以把自己的目的放在這些人們已經習慣了的事情後面，讓敵人沒有防備，然後突然攻打敵人。上文故事中，警車每天從書店前開過，賭錢的人慢慢習慣，就沒了防備。等警察突然進來抓人時，想跑已經晚了。
    現在，也有“瞞天過海”這樣的事情，它是一個成語。
    比如，你和同學們都在學校裡學漢語，開始的時候，大家的漢語都不太好。幾個月後，學校有漢語考試。考試完，大家發現，有位同學的成績比大家好很多。你不明白，都是一樣在學校裡學習，為什麼這位同學的成績比大家好這麼多呢？後來你發現，這位同學除了在學校裡學漢語，也在學校外面找了老師學漢語。在你們不知道的地方和你們不知道的時間裡，他都在學習，但他沒有告訴你們，因為他希望他的漢語比每個人都好。這時候，你就可以說：“同學，你這是在瞞天過海，明天我也會多學習的！”

sentences.simplified: 瞒天过海是三十六计中的第一计。
sentences.traditional: 瞞天過海是三十六計中的第一計。
sentences.pinyin: mán tiān guò hǎi shì sān shí liù jì zhōng de dì yī jì
sentences.english: “Deceive the heavens to cross the sea” is the first stratagem of the Thirty-Six Stratagems.

sentences.simplified: 有些事情，因为经常发生，人们已经习惯了，所以会相信。
sentences.traditional: 有些事情，因為經常發生，人們已經習慣了，所以會相信。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu xiē shì qing yīn wèi jīng cháng fā shēng rén men yǐ jīng xí guàn le suǒ yǐ huì xiāng xìn
sentences.english: People become accustomed to some things because they happen frequently, so they will trust them.

sentences.simplified: 在攻打敌人时，我们可以把自己的目的放在这些人们已经习惯了的事情后面，
sentences.traditional: 在攻打敵人時，我們可以把自己的目的放在這些人們已經習慣了的事情後面，
sentences.pinyin: zài gōng dǎ dí rén shí wǒ men kě yǐ bǎ zì jǐ de mù dì fàng zài zhè xiē rén men yǐ jīng xí guàn le de shì qing hòu miàn
sentences.english: When attacking the enemy, we can hide our intentions behind the things these people are already accustomed to, ..

sentences.simplified: 让敌人没有防备，然后突然攻打敌人。
sentences.traditional: 讓敵人沒有防備，然後突然攻打敵人。
sentences.pinyin: ràng dí rén méi yǒu fáng bèi rán hòu tū rán gōng dǎ dí rén
sentences.english: .. catching the enemy off guard and then launching a sudden attack on the enemy.

sentences.simplified: 上文故事中，警车每天从书店前开过，赌钱的人慢慢习惯，就没了防备。
sentences.traditional: 上文故事中，警車每天從書店前開過，賭錢的人慢慢習慣，就沒了防備。
sentences.pinyin: shàng wén gù shi zhōng jǐng chē měi tiān cóng shū diàn qián kāi guò dǔ qián de rén màn man xí guàn jiù méi le fáng bèi
sentences.english: In this story, the police car passed by the bookstore every day. The gamblers gradually got used to this and let their guard down.

sentences.simplified: 等警察突然进来抓人时，想跑已经晚了。
sentences.traditional: 等警察突然進來抓人時，想跑已經晚了。
sentences.pinyin: děng jǐng chá tū rán jìn lái zhuā rén shí xiǎng pǎo yǐ jīng wǎn le
sentences.english: When the police suddenly came in to arrest people, it was already too late to run away.

sentences.simplified: 现在，也有“瞒天过海”这样的事情，它是一个成语。
sentences.traditional: 現在，也有“瞞天過海”這樣的事情，它是一個成語。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài yě yǒu mán tiān guò hǎi zhè yàng de shì qing tā shì yí ge chéng yǔ
sentences.english: There are also things like “deceiving the heaven to cross the sea” nowadays. It is an idiom.

sentences.simplified: 比如，你和同学们都在学校里学汉语，开始的时候，大家的汉语都不太好。
sentences.traditional: 比如，你和同學們都在學校裡學漢語，開始的時候，大家的漢語都不太好。
sentences.pinyin: bǐ rú nǐ hé tóng xué men dōu zài xué xiào lǐ xué hàn yǔ kāi shǐ de shí hou dà jiā de hàn yǔ dōu bú tài hǎo
sentences.english: For example, you and your classmates were learning Chinese in school. In the beginning, everyone’s Chinese was not very good.

sentences.simplified: 几个月后，学校有汉语考试。
sentences.traditional: 幾個月後，學校有漢語考試。
sentences.pinyin: jǐ ge yuè hòu xué xiào yǒu hàn yǔ kǎo shì
sentences.english: A few months later, there was a Chinese test at the school.

sentences.simplified: 考试完，大家发现，有位同学的成绩比大家好很多。
sentences.traditional: 考試完，大家發現，有位同學的成績比大家好很多。
sentences.pinyin: kǎo shì wán dà jiā fā xiàn yǒu wèi tóng xué de chéng jì bǐ dà jiā hǎo hěn duō
sentences.english: After the test, everyone discovered that one classmate’s score was much better than everyone else’s.

sentences.simplified: 你不明白，都是一样在学校里学习，为什么这位同学的成绩比大家好这么多呢？
sentences.traditional: 你不明白，都是一樣在學校裡學習，為什麼這位同學的成績比大家好這麼多呢？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ bù míng bai dōu shì yí yàng zài xué xiào lǐ xué xí wèi shén me zhè wèi tóng xué de chéng jì bǐ dà jiā hǎo zhè me duō ne
sentences.english: You didn’t understand. Everyone was studying in the same school. Why was this student’s performance so much better than everyone else’s?

sentences.simplified: 后来你发现，这位同学除了在学校里学汉语，也在学校外面找了老师学汉语。
sentences.traditional: 後來你發現，這位同學除了在學校裡學漢語，也在學校外面找了老師學漢語。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái nǐ fā xiàn zhè wèi tóng xué chú le zài xué xiào lǐ xué hàn yǔ yě zài xué xiào wài miàn zhǎo le lǎo shī xué hàn yǔ
sentences.english: Later, you found out that besides studying Chinese at school, this student also found a teacher outside of school to learn Chinese.

sentences.simplified: 在你们不知道的地方和你们不知道的时间里，他都在学习，
sentences.traditional: 在你們不知道的地方和你們不知道的時間裡，他都在學習，
sentences.pinyin: zài nǐ men bù zhī dào de dì fang hé nǐ men bù zhī dào de shí jiān lǐ tā dōu zài xué xí
sentences.english: In places and times unknown to you, he was always studying.

sentences.simplified: 但他没有告诉你们，因为他希望他的汉语比每个人都好。
sentences.traditional: 但他沒有告訴你們，因為他希望他的漢語比每個人都好。
sentences.pinyin: dàn tā méi yǒu gào su nǐ men yīn wèi tā xī wàng tā de hàn yǔ bǐ měi ge rén dōu hǎo
sentences.english: But he didn’t tell you because he hoped that his Chinese would be better than everyone else’s.

sentences.simplified: 这时候，你就可以说：“同学，你这是在瞒天过海，明天我也会多学习的！”
sentences.traditional: 這時候，你就可以說：“同學，你這是在瞞天過海，明天我也會多學習的！”
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí hou nǐ jiù kě yǐ shuō tóng xué nǐ zhè shì zài mán tiān guò hǎi míng tiān wǒ yě huì duō xué xí de
sentences.english: At this moment, you can say, “Classmate, you are ‘deceiving the heavens to cross the sea’. I will also study more in the future!”

sentence_translations: “Deceive the heavens to cross the sea” is the first stratagem of the Thirty-Six Stratagems.
People become accustomed to some things because they happen frequently, so they will trust them.
When attacking the enemy, we can hide our intentions behind the things these people are already accustomed to, ..
.. catching the enemy off guard and then launching a sudden attack on the enemy.
In this story, the police car passed by the bookstore every day. The gamblers gradually got used to this and let their guard down.
When the police suddenly came in to arrest people, it was already too late to run away.
There are also things like “deceiving the heaven to cross the sea” nowadays. It is an idiom.
For example, you and your classmates were learning Chinese in school. In the beginning, everyone’s Chinese was not very good.
A few months later, there was a Chinese test at the school.
After the test, everyone discovered that one classmate’s score was much better than everyone else’s.
You didn’t understand. Everyone was studying in the same school. Why was this student’s performance so much better than everyone else’s?
Later, you found out that besides studying Chinese at school, this student also found a teacher outside of school to learn Chinese.
In places and times unknown to you, he was always studying.
But he didn’t tell you because he hoped that his Chinese would be better than everyone else’s.
At this moment, you can say, “Classmate, you are ‘deceiving the heavens to cross the sea’. I will also study more in the future!”
